mcq.question: Her billionaire parents say she must ___ this month or her business will have to close.
mcq.full: Her billionaire parents say she must pay them back this month or her business will have to close.
mcq.vi: Bố mẹ tỷ phú nói tháng này cô ấy phải trả lại tiền cho họ nếu không công ty sẽ phải đóng cửa.
mcq.expl:
pay somebody back = repay; close down = stop operating; rip somebody off = cheat or overcharge; be held up = be delayed; do something up = renovate; bring a subject up = mention it.
pay somebody back = trả tiền lại; close down = ngừng hoạt động; rip somebody off = lừa hoặc tính giá quá cao; be held up = bị trì hoãn; do something up = sửa sang; bring up a subject = nêu vấn đề.
Điểm ngữ pháp: pay somebody back = trả tiền lại.
mcq.key: Her billionaire parents say she must ___ this month or her business will have to close.|pay them back

mcq.question: Her business will have to ___ if she cannot repay the money.
mcq.full: Her business will have to close down if she cannot repay the money.
mcq.vi: Công ty của cô ấy sẽ phải đóng cửa nếu không thể trả lại tiền.
mcq.expl:
pay somebody back = repay; close down = stop operating; rip somebody off = cheat or overcharge; be held up = be delayed; do something up = renovate; bring a subject up = mention it.
pay somebody back = trả tiền lại; close down = ngừng hoạt động; rip somebody off = lừa hoặc tính giá quá cao; be held up = bị trì hoãn; do something up = sửa sang; bring up a subject = nêu vấn đề.
Điểm ngữ pháp: close down = ngừng hoạt động.
mcq.key: Her business will have to ___ if she cannot repay the money.|close down

mcq.question: Customers claimed that Highbridge ___ with poor goods and inefficient service.
mcq.full: Customers claimed that Highbridge ripped them off with poor goods and inefficient service.
mcq.vi: Khách hàng cho rằng Highbridge đã lừa họ bằng hàng kém và dịch vụ yếu.
mcq.expl:
pay somebody back = repay; close down = stop operating; rip somebody off = cheat or overcharge; be held up = be delayed; do something up = renovate; bring a subject up = mention it.
pay somebody back = trả tiền lại; close down = ngừng hoạt động; rip somebody off = lừa hoặc tính giá quá cao; be held up = bị trì hoãn; do something up = sửa sang; bring up a subject = nêu vấn đề.
Điểm ngữ pháp: rip somebody off = lừa hoặc tính giá quá cao.
mcq.key: Customers claimed that Highbridge ___ with poor goods and inefficient service.|ripped them off

mcq.question: Her business development plans ___ by the family’s attitude.
mcq.full: Her business development plans had been held up by the family’s attitude.
mcq.vi: Kế hoạch phát triển công ty của cô ấy đã bị trì hoãn vì thái độ của gia đình.
mcq.expl:
pay somebody back = repay; close down = stop operating; rip somebody off = cheat or overcharge; be held up = be delayed; do something up = renovate; bring a subject up = mention it.
pay somebody back = trả tiền lại; close down = ngừng hoạt động; rip somebody off = lừa hoặc tính giá quá cao; be held up = bị trì hoãn; do something up = sửa sang; bring up a subject = nêu vấn đề.
Điểm ngữ pháp: be held up = bị trì hoãn.
mcq.key: Her business development plans ___ by the family’s attitude.|had been held up

mcq.question: She asked for extra capital so they could ___ the dated stores.
mcq.full: She asked for extra capital so they could do them up the dated stores.
mcq.vi: Cô xin thêm vốn để sửa sang các cửa hàng cũ kỹ.
mcq.expl:
pay somebody back = repay; close down = stop operating; rip somebody off = cheat or overcharge; be held up = be delayed; do something up = renovate; bring a subject up = mention it.
pay somebody back = trả tiền lại; close down = ngừng hoạt động; rip somebody off = lừa hoặc tính giá quá cao; be held up = bị trì hoãn; do something up = sửa sang; bring up a subject = nêu vấn đề.
Điểm ngữ pháp: do something up = sửa sang.
mcq.key: She asked for extra capital so they could ___ the dated stores.|do them up

mcq.question: Every time she ___, her family said she had to wait.
mcq.full: Every time she brought the subject up, her family said she had to wait.
mcq.vi: Mỗi lần cô nêu vấn đề đó, gia đình lại bảo cô phải chờ.
mcq.expl:
pay somebody back = repay; close down = stop operating; rip somebody off = cheat or overcharge; be held up = be delayed; do something up = renovate; bring a subject up = mention it.
pay somebody back = trả tiền lại; close down = ngừng hoạt động; rip somebody off = lừa hoặc tính giá quá cao; be held up = bị trì hoãn; do something up = sửa sang; bring up a subject = nêu vấn đề.
Điểm ngữ pháp: bring a subject up = nêu vấn đề.
mcq.key: Every time she ___, her family said she had to wait.|brought the subject up

mcq.question: The driver left his vehicle while he ___ with his journey by taxi.
mcq.full: The driver left his vehicle while he went on with his journey by taxi.
mcq.vi: Người lái xe bỏ lại chiếc xe trong lúc tiếp tục hành trình bằng taxi.
mcq.expl:
go on with = continue; go off = make a sudden noise; blow up = explode; drive away = leave in a vehicle; give up = stop trying; drop off to sleep = fall asleep; ride off = leave on a bicycle.
go on with = tiếp tục; go off = phát tiếng động; blow up = phát nổ; drive away = lái xe rời đi; give up = bỏ cuộc; drop off to sleep = thiếp đi; ride off = đạp xe đi.
Điểm ngữ pháp: go on = tiếp tục.
mcq.key: The driver left his vehicle while he ___ with his journey by taxi.|went on

mcq.full: An hour later, the car’s alarm went off when it was hit by a stolen van.

go on with = continue; go off = make a sudden noise; blow up = explode; drive away = leave in a vehicle; give up = stop trying; drop off to sleep = fall asleep; ride off = leave on a bicycle.

Điểm ngữ pháp: go off = phát tiếng động.
mcq.key: An hour later, the car’s alarm ___ when it was hit by a stolen van.|went off

mcq.question: The engine of the van ___, so the thief tried to drive away in the car.
mcq.full: The engine of the van blew up, so the thief tried to drive away in the car.

mcq.expl:
go on with = continue; go off = make a sudden noise; blow up = explode; drive away = leave in a vehicle; give up = stop trying; drop off to sleep = fall asleep; ride off = leave on a bicycle.

mcq.key: The engine of the van ___, so the thief tried to drive away in the car.|blew up

mcq.full: But he gave up when the car wouldn’t start and stole a bicycle instead.

mcq.expl:
go on with = continue; go off = make a sudden noise; blow up = explode; drive away = leave in a vehicle; give up = stop trying; drop off to sleep = fall asleep; ride off = leave on a bicycle.

mcq.full: ‘I had dropped off to sleep just before midnight,’ said Michael.
mcq.vi: Michael nói: ‘Ngay trước nửa đêm tôi đã thiếp đi.’
mcq.expl:
go on with = continue; go off = make a sudden noise; blow up = explode; drive away = leave in a vehicle; give up = stop trying; drop off to sleep = fall asleep; ride off = leave on a bicycle.

mcq.question: I saw a man ___ on my bicycle!
mcq.full: I saw a man riding off on my bicycle!
mcq.vi: Tôi thấy một người đàn ông đạp xe đi bằng xe đạp của tôi!
mcq.expl:
go on with = continue; go off = make a sudden noise; blow up = explode; drive away = leave in a vehicle; give up = stop trying; drop off to sleep = fall asleep; ride off = leave on a bicycle.
go on with = tiếp tục; go off = phát tiếng động; blow up = phát nổ; drive away = lái xe rời đi; give up = bỏ cuộc; drop off to sleep = thiếp đi; ride off = đạp xe đi.

mcq.question: I’m sure we’ll all ___ this holiday with great pleasure.
mcq.full: I’m sure we’ll all look back on this holiday with great pleasure.
mcq.vi: Tôi chắc chúng ta sẽ nhớ lại kỳ nghỉ này với niềm vui.
mcq.expl:
look back on = remember; work out = calculate; plug in = connect to electricity; leave out = omit; carry on = continue; turn down = refuse; put up with = tolerate; find out = discover; put off = postpone; cut down = reduce.
look back on = nhớ lại; work out = tính ra; plug in = cắm điện; leave out = bỏ sót; carry on = tiếp tục; turn down = từ chối; put up with = chịu đựng; find out = phát hiện; put off = hoãn; cut down = cắt giảm.

mcq.key: I’m sure we’ll all ___ this holiday with great pleasure.|look back on
